name: Acme AnyCA REST plugin
description: Enrollment Only AnyCA Gateway REST plugin that works with multiple ACME Providers and DNS Providers

ca_plugin_config.name: Enabled
ca_plugin_config.description: Enable or disable this CA connector. When disabled, all operations (ping, enroll, sync) are skipped.

ca_plugin_config.name: DirectoryUrl
ca_plugin_config.description: ACME directory URL (e.g. Let's Encrypt, ZeroSSL, etc.)

ca_plugin_config.name: SignerEncryptionPhrase
ca_plugin_config.description: Used to encrypt singer information when account is saved to disk (optional)

ca_plugin_config.name: AccountStoragePath
ca_plugin_config.description: Path for ACME account storage. Defaults to %APPDATA%\AcmeAccounts on Windows or ./AcmeAccounts in containers.

ca_plugin_config.name: DnsVerificationServer
ca_plugin_config.description: DNS server used to verify TXT record propagation and to resolve CNAME delegation chains. For private/local DNS zones, set this to your authoritative DNS server IP (e.g., 10.3.10.37). Leave empty to use public DNS servers (Google, Cloudflare, etc.).
